{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Check how many loyal customers there are
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)

# Check the status of these orders: only 'completed' should count as conversion
completed_loyal = loyal_df[loyal_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Count how many loyal customers converted (completed + converted == 1)
converted_loyal = completed_loyal[completed_loyal['converted'] == 1]
n_converted_loyal = len(converted_loyal)

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

# Print results
print(f'Total loyal customers: {n_loyal}')
print(f'Completed orders among loyal: {len(completed_loyal)}')
print(f'Converted (completed + converted=1) among loyal: {n_converted_loyal}')
print(f'Fraction converted: {fraction_converted:.4f}')"}
